glance.summary: OpenAI reportedly passed $10 billion in quarterly revenue, up almost 50% from the second quarter.
TSMC plans to invest $1 billion in Anthropic and OpenAI amid wobbles in AI trade.
Google DeepMind unveiled AlphaGenome 2, an AI model that maps how DNA changes affect cells.
Meta infrastructure head Santosh Janardhan is stepping down from his role at the company.

big_pour.headline: Google DeepMind unveils AlphaGenome 2 for cell research
big_pour.summary: Google DeepMind unveiled AlphaGenome 2, an AI model that shows how DNA changes affect different cells. This detailed view could help scientists find disease causes and new treatments.
big_pour.why: It could help scientists better understand disease causes and discover new treatments.

explain.kid: Google DeepMind built a new AI tool named AlphaGenome 2 that helps scientists see how tiny changes in DNA affect different cells in our bodies.
explain.pm: Google DeepMind launched AlphaGenome 2, an AI model designed to analyze how DNA variations impact cellular function, helping researchers identify disease causes and discover new treatments.
explain.engineer: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaGenome 2, a specialized AI model that maps how genomic DNA changes affect cellular biology, helping scientists analyze complex cellular patterns and design disease treatments.

big_pour.headline: OpenAI quarterly revenue reportedly passes $10 billion
big_pour.summary: OpenAI's quarterly revenue reportedly crossed $10 billion for the first time. This represents an almost 50% jump from the $6.7 billion recorded in the second quarter.

big_pour.headline: TSMC to invest $1 billion in Anthropic and OpenAI
big_pour.summary: Taiwan's chipmaking giant TSMC plans to invest $1 billion in Anthropic and OpenAI. The investment arrives as the AI trade experiences wobbles.

office_blend.headline: Fujifilm Biotechnologies prepares legal AI agent for production
office_blend.summary: An AI agent designed by the legal team at Fujifilm Biotechnologies is preparing to move from a sandbox to full production. The agent reviews contracts, checks standards, and proposes edits.

office_blend.headline: Trovata builds autonomous treasury agents on Amazon Bedrock
office_blend.summary: Trovata built autonomous corporate treasury agents using Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore. The architecture helps move corporate treasury operations from manual work to real-time decision-making.

still_roasting.summary: Amazon's roaming Ring Robotics security devices will debut in late 2026 and early 2027.
ChatGPT is launching verified Business Agents in beta to help US users chat with brands for comparison shopping.

quick_sips.summary: Meta infrastructure head Santosh Janardhan is stepping down after joining the company in 2009.
CoreWeave is asking customers for upfront prepayments and shorter contracts to fund its AI growth.
Google is experimenting with Tabletop, an AI tool that generates customized collaboration apps from user descriptions.

stories.label: Open standard
stories.headline: Nvidia donates OpenShell runtime to the CNCF
stories.summary: Nvidia donated OpenShell to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation. OpenShell is an open-source runtime built for securing and governing AI agents.

stories.label: New tool
stories.headline: Google introduces TPU Sync to reduce inference latency
stories.summary: Google introduced TPU Sync, an open-source system designed to speed up inference latency by over 90 percent, alongside its eighth-generation hardware announcement.

concept.explanation: OpenShell is an open-source runtime created by Nvidia for securing and governing AI agents. Nvidia donated the technology to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation.

long_read.headline: Software correctness & supply chain security
long_read.summary: The newsletter highlights a discussion on software development challenges with AI, focusing on the fundamental practices of correctness and supply chain security.

sign_off: That's the last sip. See you next morning.

word.definition: Storing a model's numbers at lower precision (e.g. 4-bit instead of 16-bit) so it uses less memory and runs faster, usually with a small quality cost.
word.heard: "The 4-bit quantized model fits on a single GPU."
word.analogy: Like instant coffee: far lighter to carry, slightly less flavour.
